XXXVIII, 12', so the rejoined gloss head renders 'ch. same. . *Targ. Is. XXXVIII, 12' with two sentence terminators. Corpus-wide: 1,136 entries have a language_reference ending in a period; only 15 (this one included) also open the definition with one, and 3,312 of the 3,317 entries whose language_reference lacks the period do not.
